name: FireStream Video Host Resolver Plugin
description: Resolves external video player iframes from firestream.site, firestream.to, and related mirrors to direct HLS/MP4 CDN streams.
author: TheDesiTadka Engine

steps: 1. Extract video slug from embed URL (e.g. /e/{slug})
3. Extract base64 token blob from <script id="token-blob" type="text/plain"> element
4. Send POST request to https://{domain}/api/videos/{slug}/resolve with JSON body {"blob": "..."}
6. Play direct HLS stream (video.m3u8) from fr-cdn-*.firestream.to with proper Referer and Origin headers

headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/128.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
